senses.it: sassi di medie dimensioni accatastati alla rinfusa. Solitamente il mucchio era formato dai sassi trovati nel terreno durante l'aratura e la sarchiatura
senses.en: medium-sized stones piled up haphazardly. The heap was usually made of the stones found in the soil during ploughing and hoeing
